description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2540014792018 FRAME,SEAT,VEHICULA: Line 0001 Qty 150 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0053 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
